description_lt: Įvertintas amžius, kai pusė jaunų žmonių nebegyvena su tėvais. Tai NE amžius įsigyjant pirmą nuosavą būstą.
method: Eurostat calculates, separately by sex and in total, per-age exit probability (15-34) from EU-LFS shares; midpoint 50% no longer in parental household. It is not an observed average age at first purchase.

sources_to_read_for_future_age_stratifie.topic: 18-34 people with parents and/or sharing parental household income by age and sex
sources_to_read_for_future_age_stratifie.limitation: May include temporary absence students and workers; distinct from EU-LFS leaving-home metric.

sources_to_read_for_future_age_stratifie.topic: Tenure status by sex and age incl. Y25-34
sources_to_read_for_future_age_stratifie.limitation: Measures share of PERSONS living in owner-occupied/rented dwelling, NOT whether 25-34 individual personally owns home; parent-owned dwelling counts.

sources_to_read_for_future_age_stratifie.topic: Overcrowding by age, sex and poverty status
sources_to_read_for_future_age_stratifie.limitation: Crowding condition, not purchasing power; person-level denominator.

sources_to_read_for_future_age_stratifie.topic: Housing cost overburden by age and sex
sources_to_read_for_future_age_stratifie.limitation: >40% household disposable income spent on housing costs, among persons of age group; not mortgage eligibility.

note: 25-34 is a standard official age grouping; do not relabel as 25-35 or legal <36 young families. No unverified LT cells populated.
